words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我想要试一下这件白衬衫。(Wǒ xiǎng yào shì yíxià zhè jiàn bái chènshān.) — I'd like to try on this white shirt.
有中号的蓝色外套吗？(Yǒu zhōnghào de lánsè wàitào ma?) — Do you have this blue jacket in medium?
这条裤子有点长。(Zhè tiáo kùzi yǒudiǎnr cháng.) — These pants are a bit long.
请问这件衣服有大号吗？(Qǐngwèn zhè jiàn yīfu yǒu dàhào ma?) — Do you have a large in this garment?
我觉得中号最合身。(Wǒ juéde zhōnghào zuì héshēn.) — I think medium fits the best.
这个款式有小号吗？(Zhè ge kuǎnshì yǒu xiǎohào ma?) — Does this style come in small?
我可以试穿一下这双鞋吗？(Wǒ kěyǐ shìchuān yíxià zhè shuāng xié ma?) — May I try on this pair of shoes?
请问试衣间在哪里？(Qǐngwèn shìyījiān zài nǎlǐ?) — Where is the fitting room?
大小正合适，非常合身。(Dàxiǎo zhèng héshì, fēicháng héshēn.) — The size is just right, it fits very well.
请问这件外套今天打折吗？(Qǐngwèn zhè jiàn wàitào jīntiān dǎzhé ma?) — Is this jacket on discount today?
老板，能不能便宜一点？(Lǎobǎn, néng bu néng piányi yìdiǎnr?) — Boss, can you make it a bit cheaper?
请问这里可以付现金吗？(Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ kěyǐ fù xiànjīn ma?) — May I pay with cash here?
这件有点脏，能换一件吗？(Zhè jiàn yǒudiǎnr zāng, néng huàn yí jiàn ma?) — This one has a smudge, could I swap it for another?
我喜欢宽松一点的版型。(Wǒ xǐhuan kuānsōng yìdiǎnr de bǎnxíng.) — I prefer a looser cut.
腰部感觉稍微有一点紧。(Yāobù gǎnjué shāowēi yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐn.) — The waist feels a little bit tight.
这件T恤是纯棉的，很舒服。(Zhè jiàn T-xù shì chúnmián de, hěn shūfu.) — This T-shirt is 100% cotton, very comfortable.
我想买一双鞋。(Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng xié.) — I want to buy a pair of shoes.
收银台在靠近门口的地方。(Shōuyíntái zài kàojìn ménkǒu de dìfang.) — The cash register is near the exit.
请帮我开一张发票。(Qǐng bāng wǒ kāi yì zhāng fāpiào.) — Please provide an official invoice for me.
七天之内可以凭小票退换。(Qī tiān zhīnèi kěyǐ píng xiǎopiào tuìhuàn.) — You can return or exchange within 7 days with receipt.
你觉得这条裙子合适吗？(Nǐ juéde zhè tiáo qúnzi héshì ma?) — Do you think this skirt is suitable?
请看领子后面的标价。(Qǐng kàn lǐngzi hòumian de biāojià.) — Please look at the tag price behind the collar.
这件外套有特大号的吗？(Zhè jiàn wàitào yǒu tèdàhào de ma?) — Is this coat available in extra large?
电子手表全国联保保修一年。(Diànzǐ shǒubiǎo quánguó liánbǎo bǎoxiū yì nián.) — Electronic watch has one-year nationwide warranty.
